tagline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen; the ICJ finds genocide in Myanmar; the IEA sounds an oil alarm; Anthropic debuts

pictured.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
pictured.subhead: Joint peace declaration in Shenzhen skips Ukraine and Iran

pictured.headline: ICJ rules Myanmar committed Rohingya genocide
pictured.subhead: Judges in The Hague vote 9-6; court cites about 10,000 killed in 2017

pictured.headline: IEA: Iran war is history's worst energy threat
pictured.subhead: Agency counts 2.8 billion barrels of Gulf oil lost so far

pictured.headline: Anthropic shares close up 17% on market debut
pictured.subhead: Stock ends at $97.17, against the $83 IPO price set on 18 Nov

pictured.headline: Putin rules out energy and Black Sea truce
pictured.subhead: After a third Crimea bridge strike in a week, he vows a harsh reply

pictured.headline: Dutch and Austrian embassies damaged in Kyiv
pictured.subhead: No staff hurt; the Netherlands summons Russia's ambassador

pictured.headline: Senate blocks a bid to curb the Iran war
pictured.subhead: War-powers measure fails 48-51; 3 Republicans vote yes

pictured.headline: Iran says two Hormuz tankers hit mines
pictured.subhead: IRGC says the ships carried over 4 million barrels; not verified

pictured.headline: Somalia gives UAE envoy 72 hours to leave
pictured.subhead: Mogadishu recalls its own ambassador and alleges an invasion

pictured.headline: Senegal's president enacts budget by decree
pictured.subhead: Faye bypasses parliament to keep a $2.2bn IMF plan alive

pictured.headline: Odisha moves about 298,000 before cyclone
pictured.subhead: Relief chief: 2.98 lakh shifted; Akvan landfall due 20 Nov

pictured.headline: Bangladesh sends border guards to protests
pictured.subhead: 97 platoons deployed as the Awami League calls a shutdown

pictured.headline: Bukele files to seek a third term
pictured.subhead: El Salvador's president registers; Reuters cites polls of 55% to 70%

pictured.headline: Tonga declares a 27-day drought emergency
pictured.subhead: Order covers all of Tonga from 19 Nov to 16 Dec as El Niño bites

pictured.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil-fuel language
pictured.subhead: A draft, not a final deal; it also cuts a $120 billion adaptation target

pictured.headline: NASA confirms Voyager 1 is a light-day away
pictured.subhead: Probe is 16.1 billion miles out; it crossed the mark on 18 Nov
